svg.text: S3 layout for data plane v2
One bucket per data plane and region. Every object is written once and never changed; cell state says which ones are current.
segment writer: one object per flush
sections: events | messages | prompts + footer index
files, attachments, images, memory files; shared by fork/copy
last three kept; for replica catch-up and recovery
snapshots when far behind; paging in
Conditional PUT (If-None-Match: *); a retry finds the same key. Nothing is overwritten.
Session log ranges, blob manifests and the index catalog are Raft state; S3 is never listed on a hot path.
Export, deletion and per-org KMS context work by prefix; random org ids spread load over S3 partitions.
SSE-KMS with bucket keys; secrets are never stored in S3 except sealed inside Raft snapshots.
Superseded compaction segments and old snapshots deleted after a grace period; cold history to Intelligent-Tiering.
Deleting a session or org is a tombstone in cell state; bytes are removed only by an explicit org deletion job.
